# The library's form controls hand a handler the value their event declares,
# run on every target a test can execute on.
#
# testdata/ui_event_params.txtar is the code; this is the answer. A checkbox's
# trigger writes the var `:checked` bound before the handler reads it, a toggle
# nobody binds reports its state, an input's text reaches the bound var and the
# handler, a datepicker's day writes `:value`, and a click runs its handler.
# A trigger's argument is bound as an emit's is, by position or by name.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import time "sngl:time"

component main node {
    var on = false
    var lit = false
    var name = ""
    var picked option[time.date] = null
    var seen = "none"
    var clicks = 0
    vbox {
        checkbox #box(:checked=on, label="a", @change(checked) { seen = "box {checked} {on}" })
        toggle #sw(checked=lit, label="b", @change(checked) {
            lit = checked
            seen = "sw {checked}"
        })
        input #field(:value=name, @input(value) { seen = "input {value} {name}" })
        datepicker #day(:value=picked, @change(value) { seen = value == null ? "no day" : "day" })
        button #press(text="go", @click { clicks += 1 })
        text(value=seen)
    }
}

func testCheckbox(t Test, c main) {
    c.box.change(true)
    t.assert(c.seen == "box true true")
    t.assert(c.on == true)
    c.box.change(false)
    t.assert(c.seen == "box false false")
    t.assert(c.on == false)
}

func testToggle(t Test, c main) {
    c.sw.change(true)
    t.assert(c.seen == "sw true")
    t.assert(c.lit == true)
    c.sw.change(checked=false)
    t.assert(c.seen == "sw false")
    t.assert(c.lit == false)
}

func testInput(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.input("ada")
    t.assert(c.seen == "input ada ada")
    t.assert(c.name == "ada")
}

func testDatepicker(t Test, c main) {
    var d time.date = "2024-03-05"
    c.day.change(d)
    t.assert(c.picked == d)
    t.assert(c.seen == "day")
}

func testButton(t Test, c main) {
    c.press.click()
    c.press.click()
    t.assert(c.clicks == 2)
}

window {
    main
}
